_doc: Belt item sounds (BeltSfx, docs/AUDIO.md), keyed by belt item id (content/utility): start = played at the Hunter when the item is used; loop = held while it channels (tonic, armor_kit); end = the channel finished; cancel = the channel was spilt (hit, stunned, rolled). Keys (rift_key, chest_key) have their own sounds in BeltKeys. --sfx-set-check asserts every other belt item is here with no shared stock cue.
